scope: Completed R02 supervised A2A task integration; configured runtime and filesystem controls versus saved C3.26, plus full remote workload baseline.
execution: All retained measurements sequential after tests/builds terminated; filesystem reverse repeat prompted by initial 12–18% list/edit median variation. Both orders retained.

build.strip_method: platform strip on a copy; timings use original release executable

method.configuration: explicit deployment file; re-resolved per admitted task
method.cache: warm filesystem; no forced cache eviction
method.workload: 2 local HTTP calls, one bare printf shell command, 32 final output deltas (512 text bytes)
method.startup: Node monotonic spawn to first loopback provider request arrival; separate --version process wall time
method.baseline: direct core run_with_tools in measurement host; SDK/provider/tool construction excluded from core_run_ms
method.acp: official TS SDK; one new process/session/prompt per sample; prompt includes per-run provider/tool/SDK setup; total excludes deliberate RSS wait and session creation
method.first_delta: server write of one text delta to TS client update; local HTTP/SSE and ACP; provider waits 40 ms before finishing
method.reuse: up to 40 measured independent sessions per process after five warm-up tasks; prompt timing excludes session creation; same HTTP/shell workload
method.rss: ps RSS in KiB 50 ms after ACP initialize; one fresh process per sample
method.events: normalized ProviderEvent yield to inline TextDelta sink entry; includes measurement mutex/clock; 1000 x 32-byte deltas per run
method.trace: same event workload with/without metadata-only buffered JSONL; includes writer flush but excludes file creation; no fsync
method.limits: single-run warm-cache microbenchmarks; no network/TLS/model latency; no concurrency or remote provider claim
